other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Jammu & Kashmir
Must have engaged in building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months
Registration with the Board is renewed annually
Applicant must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Jammu & Kashmir
Applicant should be suffering from an injury, a disability, or a chronic disease
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to ₹1,00,000 for injury, temporary or permanent disability, and chronic disease treatment.
